description: A JavaScript source file that contains functions for setting return values in different forms related to products, inventory, and tasks within the vtiger CRM system. It also writes a script tag to include Inventory.js.

methods.name: set_return(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets product-related values in different forms depending on the 'from_link' element. It communicates selected product data back to the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_specific(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets product name and id in the opener window's form fields using 'getOpenerObj' helper function.

methods.name: set_return_formname_specific(formname,product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets product name and id in a specified form in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_inventory(product_id,product_name,unitprice,qtyinstock,curr_row)
methods.description: Populates inventory item details in the parent window's form elements, including name, id, unit price, and stock quantity, and focuses on the quantity input.

methods.name: set_return_todo(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets task parent name and id in the opener window, depending on whether 'from_link' element is set.
